reviews.text: Excellent dog walking, care of dog

"Trust is the most important quality you can look for in someone caring for your pets, and that is exactly what we’ve found with Sugar’s Pet Services. Melissa is incredibly responsive and kind, often helping us out when we’re in a hurry. Our caregiver, Alexi, is a total gem—trustworthy, helpful, and so patient. He has been instrumental in helping us transition a new kitten into our home with our rather anxious and 'set-in-her-ways' older cat. Even when he has to navigate tricky logistics to get into the house while we’re away, he never complains. We wholeheartedly recommend this company to everyone, especially first-timers. It truly opens up your world, allowing you to travel or work long days knowing your animals are happy, relaxed, and receiving 100% of the care they deserve. Thank you, Sugar’s!"  - PS, you get pics and a journal at every visit!!!

What a great business! I always felt like my cat was left in good hands with them. They clearly communicate with pictures and updates and make sure your pet is well taken care of. It’s such a stress reliever when you’re on vacation and not having to worry about your pets care all in the comfort of your own home. They’re typically available during holidays if you book in advance. I strongly recommend their service to anyone looking for pet sitting. I’m really hoping they expand their service areas!
They are the absolute best!! So communicative and gives great updates. So happy to have them to trust when I have to travel!
I can’t say enough about Kathlyn! She has been caring for our cats and house for 2 years and I always rest easy knowing she is there.
